# Skip the compaction space comparison when the getter is not implemented

Part 2 permits NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED from GetDiskSpaceAvailable, then unconditionally compares availableSpace with requiredSpace. The frozen accepted caller keeps that branch. At separately inspected Gecko revision 00aad09a, Unix GetDiskSpaceAvailable returns NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED without writing the output when STATFS is absent; the Windows implementation writes 0 before its disk calls. On the Unix no-STATFS branch, the caller would read an unwritten local value. Scoped proposal: compare space only when the getter succeeds, and preserve the documented skip on NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Gecko/comm pairing and supported-build reachability are unverified. This is a conditional source concern, not a reproduced build failure or a diagnosis of entry 2035. Static source and test inspection only. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending-single-browser-reader.

Scope: Compaction disk-space getter status contract.
